name: openrouteservice
description: Geocode addresses, generate drive-time isochrones, and calculate road-network travel-time matrices with OpenRouteService.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.help_text: Create a free API key at https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/signup.

geocode_address.description: Find the best matching address or place. Defaults to New Zealand and flags matches below 0.8 confidence for human confirmation.

address.description: Address or place name to search for.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter. Defaults to NZ.

is_low_confidence.description: True when the best match confidence is below 0.8; confirm before using downstream.

error_type.description: rate_limit, quota_exceeded, quota_or_unauthorized, authentication, authorization, invalid_request, not_found, not_acceptable, provider_error, or request_failed.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Same values as error_type.

get_isochrone.description: Generate exact OpenRouteService GeoJSON drive-time polygons for a point and one or more minute bands. Features include a stable time_minutes property, are returned in ascending band order, and are not simplified. Optionally export the FeatureCollection as a platform file.

time_minutes.description: One to ten driving-time bands in whole minutes (1-60), for example [5, 10, 15, 30]. Catchment workflows typically send one to five bands; the public API limit is 10.

export_geojson.description: If true, return the FeatureCollection as a platform file object in files (name, contentType, base64 content). Default false.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Geometry is unsmoothed; each feature has time_minutes. Bands are sorted ascending.

provider_metadata.description: Unmodified metadata returned by OpenRouteService, when supplied.

files.description: Platform file objects when export_geojson is true.

content.description: The file content encoded as base64

error_type.description: rate_limit, quota_exceeded, quota_or_unauthorized, authentication, authorization, invalid_request, not_found, not_acceptable, provider_error, or request_failed.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Same values as error_type.

get_travel_time_matrix.description: Return driving durations in seconds, and optional distances in metres, for each labelled origin-destination pair. Unreachable routes are null. At most 10000 pairs (origins × destinations). Large requests are split into provider-compliant batches. Optionally export compact JSON.

origins.description: Start points. Each item needs a unique caller-defined id plus WGS84 latitude and longitude. At most 10000 items. Combined with destinations, at most 10000 origin-destination pairs (invalid_request if the product is larger).

id.description: Caller-defined label preserved in the result.

destinations.description: End points. Each item needs a unique caller-defined id plus WGS84 latitude and longitude. At most 10000 items. Combined with origins, at most 10000 origin-destination pairs (invalid_request if the product is larger).

id.description: Caller-defined label preserved in the result.

include_distance.description: If true, also return road-network distances in metres. Default false.

export_format.description: If json, also return the compact matrix as a platform file in files (name, contentType, base64 content).

origins.description: Requested origins in input order, with provider snapping when supplied.

destinations.description: Requested destinations in input order, with provider snapping when supplied.

pairs.description: Origin-major, destination-minor pairs. duration_seconds and distance_metres are unrounded numbers or null.

provider_metadata.description: OpenRouteService metadata when supplied. If the matrix was split across provider calls, query, timestamp, and id are omitted because they describe only one chunk.

files.description: Platform file objects when export_format is json.

content.description: The file content encoded as base64

error_type.description: rate_limit, quota_exceeded, quota_or_unauthorized, authentication, authorization, invalid_request, not_found, not_acceptable, timeout, provider_error, or request_failed.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Same values as error_type.
